title: Gas-Move Credit on Small Business Electricity Supply Site Transfer Fees
content:
**Gas-move credit.** On the site transfer fee of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement: when the business has a Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement pending enrollment, its gas following it, 12.00 dollars come off the site transfer fee; when the business has no pending one but holds an active Beacon Ridge commercial gas agreement, 6.00 dollars come off; when it holds neither, nothing comes off.

## Records read

The business's Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreements and their status, at any of its sites.

| Business's Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreements | Gas-move credit |
|---|---|
| at least one enrollment pending (whether or not another is active) | 12.00 USD off |
| none enrollment pending, at least one active | 6.00 USD off |
| none enrollment pending and none active | nothing off |

## Points of judgement

- The credit reads the business's gas agreements at any of its sites, not only those at the old or the new electricity site.
- An enrollment-pending gas agreement decides the 12.00 USD tier; an active one decides the 6.00 USD tier only when none is pending.
- A closed or rescinded gas agreement is neither pending nor active.
